about: Pages removed on October 30, 2026, when the site became a home page, three decks and use cases, each with the place its content moved to. The not-found page lists them; nothing redirects. Frozen pages may still link to a removed page, and scripts/check.py allows only that.

not_found.title: Page not found | ta-amps
not_found.heading: This page isn’t here
not_found.lead: The link may be old, or the page may have moved. Deck versions never move, so a versioned deck link still works.
